verdict.rationale: Agent-oriented documentation is a fair question for a developer-facing SaaS like Okta, but direct probes found nothing: llms.txt returned 404 and the markdown docs endpoint returned 404. The official MCP server is a separate capability that lets agents call Okta's APIs; it is not agent-oriented docs, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
